name: Adrenocortical Carcinoma (TCGA, Firehose Legacy)
description: TCGA Adrenocortical Carcinoma. Source data from GDAC Firehose. Previously known as TCGA Provisional.

name: Adenoid Cystic Carcinoma (MSK, Nat Genet 2013)
description: Whole-exome or whole-genome sequencing analysis of 60 ACC tumor/normal pairs

name: Adenoid Cystic Carcinoma (FMI, Am J Surg Pathl. 2014)
description: Targeted Sequencing of 28 metastatic Adenoid Cystic Carcinoma samples.
citation: Ross et al. Am J Surg Pathl 2014

name: Adenoid Cystic Carcinoma (JHU, Cancer Prev Res 2016)
description: Whole-genome or whole-exome sequencing of 25 adenoid cystic carcinoma tumor/normal pairs.
citation: Rettig et al, Cancer Prev Res 2016

name: Adenoid Cystic Carcinoma (MDA, Clin Cancer Res 2015)
description: WGS of 21 salivary ACCs and targeted molecular analyses of a validation set (81 patients).
citation: Mitani et al. Clin Cancer Res 2015

name: Adenoid Cystic Carcinoma (MGH, Nat Gen 2016)
description: Whole-genome/exome sequencing of 10 ACC PDX models.
